rounds.q: How many minutes does the average US worker take to get to work?
rounds.why: About 1 in 11 US workers spends over an hour getting to work each way.
rounds.src: US Census Bureau, American Community Survey (2024)
rounds.fun: 27 minutes each way is 54 minutes round trip. Lots of time for daydreaming!

rounds.q: What % of US workers drive to work alone?
rounds.why: Only 3.7% take public transit, fewer than the 13% who work from home.
rounds.src: US Census Bureau, American Community Survey (2024)
rounds.fun: 69% drive solo and only 3.7% take transit. That's a lot of empty passenger seats!

rounds.q: What % of all trips in the Netherlands are made by bicycle?
rounds.why: Cycling bounced back in 2022 to its usual pre-pandemic share.
rounds.fun: 28% of Dutch trips are by bike. Ring ring, coming through!

rounds.q: How many bicycles do the Dutch own?
rounds.why: That's more bikes than people: the Netherlands has about 17 million residents.
rounds.fun: 23 million bikes for about 17 million people. Need a spare? The Dutch have plenty!

rounds.q: How many flights did the world's airlines fly in 2024?
rounds.why: That year there was one accident of any kind per 880,000 flights.
rounds.fun: 41 million flights and one accident per 880,000 flights. Sit back and relax!
